name: yesslip
description: Multi-tenant registration, signed consent and Morning payments for small businesses

scripts.db:up: docker start yesslip-pg || docker run -d --name yesslip-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=yesslip -e POSTGRES_USER=yesslip -e POSTGRES_DB=yesslip -p 5433:5432 postgres:18-alpine
scripts.db:psql: docker exec -it yesslip-pg psql -U yesslip -d yesslip
